notes.title: “If you forgive anyone his sins, they are forgiven”
notes.intro: The risen Jesus breathes the Spirit on the disciples and speaks of forgiving and retaining sins.

views.label: Priests absolve sins in the sacrament of confession
views.summary: Catholic and Orthodox Christians see here the authority given to the apostles and their successors to pronounce forgiveness in the sacrament of Reconciliation (Confession).

views.label: Ministers declare forgiveness; private confession is valued
views.summary: Lutherans and Anglicans keep confession and absolution as a valued practice, though not required of everyone.
views.source: Augsburg Confession, Article XI; Book of Common Prayer

views.label: The church announces forgiveness through preaching the gospel
views.summary: Many Protestants understand this as the authority to proclaim that sins are forgiven to those who believe.
